parsed.title: New replan-findings skill missing from plugin registry
parsed.detail: The unit adds a replan-findings skill (SKILL_CONTEXT_BUDGETS.json gains a "replan-findings" entry: "conditional replan entry; PHASE_APPEND.md holds the append contract..."), but the plugin manifest's skills array — provided as this slice's anchor file at tip — lists 38 skills and does not include "./skills/replan-findings" (it jumps from "./skills/review-verify" ... actually from "./skills/plan-fix" through "./skills/review-a11y" with no replan-findings entry anywhere in the array). An unregistered skill is not discoverable/loadable via the plugin, so the conditional replan entry the unit claims to ship cannot be routed to. This contradicts the unit's own declared scope ("the replan-findings skill declares a conditional replan entry").
